narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems received 2 awards so far, with an average award size of $1.4B. Northrop Grumman Systems obligations are up 124.5% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year show a multi-year view: FY21 was $1.1B, FY22 was $2B, FY23 was $2.9B, FY24 was $3.5B, FY25 was $1.3B, and FY26 is $2.9B. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Northrop Grumman Systems with $2.9B in obligations. Engineering Services is a much smaller market for Northrop Grumman Systems at $1.2M in obligations. The current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. This snapshot shows where federal money concentrated so far in FY2026 and how recent-year obligations compare to the prior five fiscal years. Use this to understand scale, industry focus, and the size of recent awards for Northrop Grumman Systems.

sections.heading: How does FY2026 compare to prior years for Northrop Grumman Systems?
